description: This file contains definitions, data structures, macros, and function declarations for a POSIX-compatible regular expression library, including support for different regex syntaxes and internal regex handling structures.

methods.name: regcomp
methods.description: Compiles a regular expression pattern into a regex_t structure.

methods.name: regexec
methods.description: Executes a compiled regex pattern against a string.

methods.name: regerror
methods.description: Provides error messages for regex errors.

methods.name: regfree
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a regex_t structure.
